comment: Swift toolchains the experiments need beyond Xcode's. Packages name one in a .swift-toolchain file; Tools/toolchain resolves, lists, installs, and records them (install/register fill in directory and bundle_id). Install sources: {"swiftly": SPEC} for releases and snapshots, {"url": TARBALL} for builds swiftly can't install (unmerged PRs: download.swift.org/tmp/pull-request/<PR>/<build>/xcode/swift-PR-<PR>-<build>-osx.tar.gz, which expire).
